name: White Bean Sun-Dried Tomato Gnocchi
description: White Bean Sun-Dried Tomato Gnocchi is an easy one pan healthy dinner that’s ready in less than 30 minutes. And it come together using classic hearty ingredients that you probably have in your kitchen right now.
author: Debi
ingredients: ½ cup sliced oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes (plus 1 tablespoon oil from the jar, divided use)
15 ounce low-sodium cannellini beans (drained and rinsed)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil from the oil packed sun-dried tomatoes in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add sun-dried tomatoes and chopped shallot; cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add broth, and cook until the liquid has mostly evaporated, about 2 minutes.
Add gnocchi and cook, stirring often, until starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Add beans and spinach and cook until the spinach is wilted, about 1 minute.
Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in cream, salt, and pepper. Stir to coat with the sauce. Serve topped with chopped basil.
